title: ConstraintAnalysis
description: SAT/SMT-style constraint analysis for requirements verification. Encodes requirements as formal constraints and checks for satisfiability.

constraints.description: All constraints extracted from requirements, codebase, and preferences

type.description: Source type: requirement (from user story), existing (from codebase), preference (from .preferences.json), derived (inferred)

natural.description: Natural language description of the constraint

formal.description: Formal representation using predicates (e.g., 'CAN(user, EDIT, post)', 'MUTABLE(post.content)')

variables.description: Variables used in the formal representation

implies.description: The implied constraint in formal notation

reason.description: Explanation of why this implication holds

conflict_type.description: Type of conflict: direct (A and NOT A), implied (via implications), temporal (ordering), preference (with .preferences.json)

explanation.description: Clear explanation of why these constraints conflict

resolution_options.description: Possible ways to resolve the conflict

satisfiability.description: Overall satisfiability: SAT (all constraints can be satisfied), UNSAT (contradiction found), UNKNOWN (cannot determine)

model.description: If SAT, an example assignment that satisfies all constraints

unsat_core.description: If UNSAT, the minimal set of conflicting constraint IDs
